paragraphs.text: Wallader the Eventual is a diminutive turtlefolk mailman on the Strixhaven campus on Arcavios .

Wallader is seen carrying a chestnut portmanteau filled with yet-to-be-delivered packages, and his shell tends to scrape against furniture as he moves. Wallader appears to be a diligent and dedicated worker, taking his job seriously despite its difficulties. He prefers traditional methods of delivery over using magic or imps, indicating a preference for a more personal and stubborn approach to his work. He enjoys talking about his job and indulging others with stories about office happenings, package delays, and the challenges of his delivery routes. This suggests that he is sociable and perhaps enjoys the attention or the opportunity to share his experiences.

Wallader delivered a package to Zimone Wola at the Firejolt Café. The package had no sender's name or address, was lightweight, and was wrapped in optical illusive paper of spiraling bricks. Zimone knew it was from her grandmother Nimiroti Wola just from its looks. Wallader mentioned that the package came in two weeks ago and apologized for the delay in its delivery, citing his taxing job as the reason. He instructed Zimone to get down from the café stool to sign off and collect her package, emphasizing his traditional and perhaps meticulous approach to his work.
